etsy_description:
Pay homage to the architects of heavy metal with this Black Sabbath-inspired gothic hoodie. From the industrial fog of Birmingham to the global stage, Black Sabbath defined an entire genre with legendary tracks like 'Paranoid' and 'Iron Man.' This pullover captures that raw, foundational energy in bold dark art graphics.

Designed for the metalhead who respects the roots. Whether you grew up on Ozzy's vocals and Tony Iommi's iconic downtuned riffs or discovered Sabbath through the generations they inspired, this hoodie connects you to the origin of everything heavy.

Premium heavyweight fleece construction delivers lasting warmth and comfort. The striking graphic design turns heads at concerts, record stores, and anywhere heavy metal culture lives. This is the gift that every classic metal fan deserves.

Built with a front kangaroo pocket, durable ribbed cuffs, soft interior fleece, and a drawstring hood for the perfect fit. Available in multiple sizes. A timeless tribute — not for everyone, only for those who know where it all began.
